source: Technology Promotion Project to Increase Productivity Around Tonle Sap (TSTD — TA 7305-CAM), watermelon (ដំណាំឪឡឹក) technical training booklet, prepared by the project's agricultural techniques and extension officer in cooperation with East West Seed International, November 2016. Contact: livleanghy@gmail.com
text:
To prepare growing medium for the watermelon nursery, mix 1 part topsoil with 1 part well-decomposed cattle manure/compost, plus roughly 3 to 4 parts rice husk ash (ផេះអង្កាម).

The diagram shows the ingredients as: black compost/ash material, rice husk ash, topsoil, and cattle-manure compost, which are combined together and mixed thoroughly by hand (shown being mixed in a group by workers), then packed into a container/drum before being used to fill seedling trays or planting bags.

After mixing, let the prepared nursery soil rest/settle for a period before filling it into trays, planting bags, or nursery pots for sowing.
